h1: text-align: left; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(30, 30, 30); margin: 1em 8px 0.6em; line-height: 33.6px;
h2: text-align: left; font-size: 21px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(30, 30, 30); margin: 1.2em 8px 0.6em; line-height: 31.5px;
h3: text-align: left; font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(30, 30, 30); margin: 1em 8px 0.5em; line-height: 28.5px;
h4: text-align: left; font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(30, 30, 30); margin: 1.6em 8px 0.6em; line-height: 25.5px; padding-left: 0.5em; border-left: 3px solid rgb(30, 30, 30);
h5: text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(63, 63, 63); margin: 0.8em 8px 0.4em; line-height: 24.0px;
h6: text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(63, 63, 63); margin: 0.8em 8px 0.4em; line-height: 24.0px;
p: text-align: justify; margin: 0px 8px 1.4em; padding: 0px; color: rgb(63, 63, 63); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 30.6px;
a: color: rgb(0, 128, 255); text-decoration: underline; font-weight: bold;
img: width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 6px; display: block; margin: 1.2em auto;
code: font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size: 15px; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 0.2em 0.4em; border-radius: 3px; color: rgb(215, 58, 73);
pre: text-align: left; margin: 0px 8px 10px; background: rgb(13, 17, 23); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0px; font-size: 15px; overflow-x: auto;
blockquote: text-align: justify; margin: 1em 8px; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-left: 4px solid rgb(220, 220, 220); background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03); color: rgb(99, 99, 99);
ul: text-align: left; margin: 0.6em 8px; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: disc;
ol: text-align: left; margin: 0.6em 8px; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: decimal;
li: text-align: justify; margin: 0.3em 0; color: rgb(63, 63, 63); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 30.6px;
table: text-align: left; margin: 1em 8px; border-collapse: collapse; width: calc(100% - 16px); font-size: 15px;
th: text-align: left; padding: 0.5em 0.8em; border: 1px solid rgb(229, 229, 229); font-weight: bold; background-color: rgb(248, 248, 248); color: rgb(30, 30, 30); line-height: 24.0px;
td: text-align: left; padding: 0.5em 0.8em; border: 1px solid rgb(229, 229, 229); color: rgb(63, 63, 63); line-height: 24.0px;
hr: border-style: solid; border-width: 1px 0 0; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); margin: 1em 0;
